title: SkyDrive and Kyushu Electric Power sign comprehensive partnership agreement to integrate eVTOLs into urban development
summary: SkyDrive is developing and manufacturing compact eVTOL aircraft to make everyday air mobility a reality.
body_markdown:
SkyDrive Inc., a compact eVTOL aircraft developer based in Japan, and Kyushu Electric Power Co. Inc. (Kyushu Electric Power) announced that they have signed a comprehensive partnership agreement to jointly explore the potential of integrating eVTOL aircraft into community planning and urban development, as well as to investigate new mobility services and business opportunities to accelerate the commercial deployment of eVTOLs.


## **Background and Objectives**


In recent years, declining populations and changing lifestyles have made securing regional transit increasingly challenging across Japan.


Simultaneously, evolving transportation needs call for more versatile and diverse transit options. eVTOL aircraft are emerging as an innovative solution to address these challenges. Beyond enhancing connectivity both within and between regions, eVTOLs are expected to stimulate new flows of people and services, revitalizing local economies and enhancing overall regional value.


As an aircraft manufacturer, SkyDrive is developing and manufacturing compact eVTOL aircraft to make everyday air mobility a reality while accelerating initiatives toward commercial operations.


Meanwhile, Kyushu Electric Power strives to build sustainable local communities through community planning and urban development tailored to regional characteristics.


Through this partnership, the two companies will evaluate how eVTOL aircraft can be utilized in urban development and new mobility services.


Together, they will explore new business opportunities that address regional challenges, expand visitor populations, generate tourism demand and enhance regional value — contributing to sustainable local growth through public and private co-creation.


## Key Areas of Collaboration


Under this agreement, the two companies will collaborate on the following areas regarding eVTOL aircraft:


(1) Viability in Community and Urban Development: Assessing how eVTOL integration can enhance regional planning and urban development initiatives.


(2) Business Schemes and Stakeholder Coordination: Establishing viable operational frameworks, business models and coordination structures with relevant stakeholders.


(3) Regional Vitalization and Problem Solving: Developing tangible initiatives to address local transportation challenges and revitalize regional communities.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by SkyDrive Inc.*
